page.notes: The marginal note is set in italic type and is read as "Viæ aut plateæ urbis, & portæ"; the second word of the note is partly worn and may be "platæ". Some letters in the text are faint, especially at the line ends of lines 15–17 and near the word "templum" (line 11) and "parochiale". The catchword "ad" is partly cut off at the edge of the scan.
